# Josh Lange

> Josh Lange helps business owners take busywork off their plate with AI and custom software, and grow sales with revenue and go-to-market leadership. Both start with a free first step, and a fixed quote comes before any work. Based in Leander, TX, working with business owners across Austin and beyond.

## Two offers

- [Free AI assessment](https://joshdlange.com/assessment.html): a short call on where busywork builds up and what AI or custom software can take off your hands. Free, no obligation.
- [Free revenue strategy call](https://joshdlange.com/revenue.html): 30 minutes on where growth is stuck and your next three moves. Josh works as a fractional CRO (chief revenue officer), advisor and board member, on a defined project or part-time monthly.
